name: Birch tree
description: A slender white birch about 6 m high: a thin, gently curving chalk-white trunk with black horizontal bark marks and a dark fissured foot, thin ascending branches arching out at the tips, and a narrow airy crown of small yellow-green leaf clumps, some hanging from the branch tips.
